ARLP.market_view: price_implies: a slow decline in coal revenue with margins somewhat below the decade median, consistent with the high cash yield on a 3.25B market cap against roughly 400M of free cash flow | where_i_differ: little: my base holds margins near 15-16% for five years on contracted volumes and the latest quarter's recovery, but I still assume revenue shrinks after year 3 and a negative terminal growth

FLXS.market_view: price_implies: roughly 10x TTM after-tax operating income with no debt: about 7-8% operating margin sustained with low single-digit growth | where_i_differ: base case is close to the market; I weight a cyclical margin reversion more heavily because FY2026 margin is at a decade high and furniture demand is tied to housing and tariff costs
